g.text: — No local identity initialized • Run First Flight setup
KIN is your personal, local-first agent network. Create an identity, pair trusted
contacts, and dispatch work across autonomous agents.
Press `h` to view the Home dashboard or run `kin first-flight`.
Agents perform local and remote tasks governed by strict capability boundaries.
Inspect cards, manage availability, and connect new YAML agent definitions.
Press `a` to open the Agents workspace.
Dispatch structured goals to local or peer agents. Define clear expectations, attach
context, and track live session execution.
Press `d` to launch the Dispatch modal.
Monitor active sessions in real time. Review intermediate artifacts, inspect audit
